ab_test.decision_rule: an arm confirms its hypothesis iff the PAIRED mean(arm - A) >= +8 RUB on the coins both arms traded, the 98.75% bootstrap CI (Bonferroni over three hypotheses, alpha 0.0125) excludes 0, and the sign is the same in both halves of the run

expectation.portfolio_b1_narrow: +1..+6 RUB/trade vs A (better in 3/3 runs on a fixed exit, 2/2 on the ladder)
expectation.portfolio_b2_birth: -8..+8 RUB (model better in 2/3, the run #6 ladder lost 15.7 RUB/trade)
expectation.portfolio_b3_t0: +3..+9 RUB from removing the 1.416 % entry premium; EV itself is neutral

ab_test.power_note: paired sd ~98 RUB and ~56 trades/hour per arm: the CI half width is ~15 RUB at ~165 pairs, so a 3-hour run cannot resolve anything below ~15 RUB/trade, and an 8 RUB effect needs ~1 700 pairs after Bonferroni (~21 h at this flow)
